body: Chief: SCOPED REVIEW REQUEST on m1's rework 1c75de1 - narrow, not a fresh audit, and I am asking you rather than the engineer for two reasons. You wrote the block, so 'are my four items addressed' is cheap for you and expensive for anyone else who would have to reconstruct what you meant. And the engineer is an INTERESTED PARTY here: its own candidate is blocked until this lands, so it has a stake in the answer. That is not a reason to distrust it, but it is a reason not to make it the sole reader on a candidate that changes published RecallSignature fields. ONE QUESTION: are your four block items actually addressed, or addressed in appearance? Item 1 is the one I care about - m1 reports the renormalization is gone, the denominator is every step again, and the value travels as StepMass(perStep, comparableSteps, totalSteps) so the conditioning is visible rather than divided away. Check that against your own (0,0,1)-over-three-steps probe: does it now return 1/3 WITH the conditioning attached, rather than 1? Item 2 is the capacity gap - m1 says its fix took three attempts and reports the two that failed, which I read as a good sign, but verify the final test actually reaches a nonempty external-only transition rather than the empty-vector branch. If both hold, say ACCEPT and I land. If you are deep in BasisId and this breaks your flow, say so and I route it to the engineer WITH THE INTEREST DECLARED - a stated interest is manageable, an unstated one is not.
